tasks.title: Loader + CLI: walker-config.ts and walker-default-concurrency subcommand
definition_of_done: `reference-impl/lib/walker-config.ts` is a new file exporting `loadWalkerConfig(): { maxConcurrent: number; source: 'user' | 'default' }`. Resolution follows the design spec table: file absent or field absent → `{ maxConcurrent: 3, source: 'default' }`; positive integer → `{ maxConcurrent: N, source: 'user' }`; malformed JSON or invalid value (0, negative, float, string, null) → throws with an actionable message including the file path or field path and actual value. No AJV dependency.

`reference-impl/lib/cli.ts` contains a new `walker-default-concurrency` case. Plain form writes the resolved integer to stdout and exits 0. `--explain` form writes `max_concurrent=N (from <abs-path> | default)` to stdout and exits 0. Either form exits non-zero with a stderr error message (no stdout) when `loadWalkerConfig()` throws.

`reference-impl/tests/walker-config.test.ts` is a new file containing exactly 9 unit cases covering: (1) file absent, (2) `{}`, (3) `{ "max_concurrent": 2 }`, (4) malformed JSON, (5) `max_concurrent: 0`, (6) `max_concurrent: -1`, (7) `max_concurrent: "two"`, (8) `max_concurrent: 2.5`, (9) `max_concurrent: null`. Tests stub `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` to a temp directory.

`reference-impl/tests/cli.test.ts` is extended with 4 new cases: (1) plain form with `{ "max_concurrent": 2 }` present → stdout `2\n`, exit 0; (2) `--explain` form with same file → stdout matches `/^max_concurrent=2 \(from .+\/walker\.json\)$/`, exit 0; (3) plain form, file absent → stdout `3\n`, exit 0; (4) plain form, malformed file → exit non-zero, stderr contains the file path.
All pre-existing tests in `reference-impl/tests/` continue to pass.
acceptance_criteria: `cloverleaf-cli walker-default-concurrency` prints `2` and exits 0 when `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cloverleaf/walker.json` contains `{ "max_concurrent": 2 }`; prints `3` when the file is absent.
`cloverleaf-cli walker-default-concurrency --explain` prints a line matching `max_concurrent=N (from <abs-path> | default)` per the design spec table, using the absolute expanded path (not `~/`).

A file containing `{ "max_concurrent": 0 }` or a negative, float, string, or null value causes `cloverleaf-cli walker-default-concurrency` to exit non-zero with a clear stderr message and no stdout output.
`npm test` in `reference-impl/` passes all tests including the 13 new cases added by this task (9 in `walker-config.test.ts` + 4 in `cli.test.ts`).

tasks.title: Walker SKILL.md: replace hard-coded default with subcommand call and startup info line
definition_of_done: `reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md` step 1 no longer hard-codes the default `3`. When `--max-concurrent=N` was passed (`$MAX_FLAG` is set), `MAX` is assigned from the flag and an info line `max_concurrent=$MAX (from --max-concurrent flag)` is printed. Otherwise, `MAX=$(cloverleaf-cli walker-default-concurrency)` is called and `cloverleaf-cli walker-default-concurrency --explain` prints the startup info line.

If `cloverleaf-cli walker-default-concurrency` exits non-zero in step 1, the walker stops and reports the error to the operator with the message "Fix or remove `~/.config/cloverleaf/walker.json` and retry.", consistent with the existing step-0 uncommitted-changes stop-and-report pattern.
Exactly one info line is printed at walker startup on every invocation (flag path, user-config path, or default path).

`reference-impl/tests/skills.test.ts` is extended with 1 new regression case asserting that `cloverleaf-run-plan/SKILL.md` step 1 contains both the string `cloverleaf-cli walker-default-concurrency` (plain form) and the string `cloverleaf-cli walker-default-concurrency --explain` (explain form).
All pre-existing tests in `reference-impl/tests/` continue to pass.
acceptance_criteria: `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cloverleaf/walker.json` containing `{ "max_concurrent": 2 }` causes the walker to operate with cap 2 on every invocation without the operator passing `--max-concurrent`.
The walker prints exactly one info line at startup on every invocation naming the resolved value and its source (flag, user config file path, or default).
A malformed `walker.json` causes the walker to stop at step 1 and display a 'Fix or remove' error message rather than silently falling back to the default.
`--max-concurrent=N` passed at invocation time overrides the user config file (precedence: flag > user config > default).
`npm test` in `reference-impl/` passes all tests including the 1 new regression case added by this task in `skills.test.ts`.

acceptance_criteria: `reference-impl/CHANGELOG.md` contains a section header matching `## 0.6.4` and enumerates the loader+CLI work (CLV-58) and the SKILL.md change (CLV-59).
